capture.placeholder: A thought, a task, a link
capture.hint: Enter: add · Shift+Enter: new line · Esc: close
capture.noWorkspace: Quick capture needs the workspace, which this browser can't provide.
capture.voice.afterStop: No live transcription (the dictation model is not installed, or the language is not Hebrew): the recording is transcribed on this device when you stop.
capture.globalShortcut.taken: ⌥⌘N is taken by another app, so it does not open Lumen from other apps. Inside Lumen, ⌥⌘N and File ▸ Quick capture still work.
capture.triage.running: Sorting the inbox with the local model…
capture.triage.nothing: Nothing to sort: every entry is already sorted
capture.triage.noModel: No local model is available to sort the inbox (Chrome's built-in model, Ollama or web-llm)
capture.triage.failedSome: No local model could sort {count} entries
